o1.biggest_mistake: It misses the strongest COD/RTO move in the data by treating the threshold as one rule for everyone instead of recommending a prepaid-vs-COD approach or COD fee under ₹500.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Make bundle one the obvious face wash + serum routine at a sensible price, tighten a few maths points, and bring COD/RTO directly into the shipping recommendation with a clear owner-level profit comparison.
